biotools.summary: HiFiBGC is a command-line workflow for identifying biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) in PacBio HiFi metagenomes. The workflow leverages an ensemble of assemblies to improve BGC recovery and is available on GitHub under the MIT license.
